'''Entertainment Center''' was a street located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was part of the processional route for the [[Shaldania Parade]] held during [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]].
